newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: Austria's central bank on Thursday called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged rate of three percent and said it had left its key interest rates unchanged.
Bids have to be in by 10 a.m. (0900 GMT) on Friday, the Austrian National Bank said.
Last week, the bank allotted 4.99 billion schillings in two-week repos, filling five percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate has been at 2.5 percent since April, while the Lombard emergency borrowing rate is at 4.75 percent. The Gomex money market rate stands at 3.4 percent.
